publication.title: Getting Formal Ontologies Closer to Final Users Through Knowledge Graph Visualization: Interpretation and Misinterpretation

source_reading.scope: Abstract and scope, complete visualizer/views/search (§3), user-interpretation discussion and conclusion (§§4–5).

adjudication.basis: OB-KGV implements interactive search/query and customizable schema/data/KG views for populated OWL ontologies. It addresses instance data as well as schema, so this is broader than an ontology-schema-only visualizer; user validation is explicitly absent.
